summary.en: This update fixes a Level 26 progression lock caused by carrying refractor equipment into the Newtonian assembly lesson.
summary.zh: 本次更新修复了第 26 关因折射式望远镜零件残留到牛顿反射式组装课而造成的卡关问题。

items.en: Entering or loading Level 26 now selects the Newtonian assembly bench and removes incompatible refractor-only parts from the active equipment set.
items.zh: 进入或载入第 26 关时，游戏现在会正确切换到牛顿反射式组装台，并移除当前装备中不兼容的折射式专用零件。

items.en: Automatic equipment and the parts cabinet can no longer leave a starter tube, objective lens or focus knob equipped on a reflector bench.
items.zh: 一键装备和零件柜现在不会再把入门镜筒、物镜或调焦旋钮保留在反射式望远镜组装台上。

items.en: Existing saves already stopped at Level 26 are repaired when loaded; players can continue with the same save.
items.zh: 已经停在第 26 关的旧存档会在载入时自动修复，玩家无需重新开档。

items.en: The observer who supplied the reproducible report has received a permanent field-research honor, a signal-gold avatar frame, and access to the in-game developer console without receiving website administration privileges.
items.zh: 提供可复现报告的观测者已获得永久现场研究荣誉、信标金环头像框，以及游戏内开发者调试台权限；该权限不包含网站后台管理能力。

footer.en: Thank you for testing carefully enough to turn a hard-to-find lock into a fixable report.
footer.zh: 感谢你认真测试并给出可复现步骤，让这个难以定位的卡关问题能够被修复。
